The Lease Term shall commence on March 1, 2023 and terminate on February 28, 2028.
Base Rent shall be as follows: Year 1: $8,000.00; Year 2: $8,240.00; Year 3: $8,487.00; Year 4: $8,742.00; Year 5: $9,004.00.

notes: Year 2's rate ($8,240) takes effect on the 1-year anniversary (2024-03-01), Year 3 on the 2-year anniversary (2025-03-01), etc. Year 1 is the starting rent, not a future trigger -- only 4 trigger dates for a 5-year schedule.
